element.description: The element the session belongs to

texts.description: The text boxes the learner added

width.description: Width of the drawing area when the session was saved; delivery restores the drawing area to it

type.description: The tool that drew the shape

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the shape was drawn; it orders undo

fillColor.description: Fill color of rectangles and circles

outlineColor.description: Outline color of rectangles and circles

paintColor.description: Color applied with the paint tool

points.description: Flat x, y coordinate list of free paths and eraser strokes

posX.description: x offset after the shape was dragged

posY.description: y offset after the shape was dragged

x.description: End x of lines and rectangles; center x of circles

y.description: End y of lines and rectangles; center y of circles

DrawingResponseDrawable.description: A shape the learner drew, serialized from its drawing tool.

text.description: The text shown on the canvas

value.description: The value of the text box's editor

label.description: Placeholder shown before the learner edits the text box

isDefault.description: Indicates the text box still shows its placeholder

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the text box was added; it orders undo

textVisible.description: Indicates the text node is shown

transformerVisible.description: Indicates the resize handles are shown

DrawingResponseText.description: A text box the learner added. It also carries the Konva text node's attributes (scale, rotation, font size).
